trigger: 用户裁定 A: 读 The Debrief 原论文后做只读自检探针

based_on.secondary: The Debrief 2026-11-27 The Brain's Hidden Chemical Code...
based_on.primary: Marx & Gilon 2026 Consciousness, Memory and Intelligence: A Mechanistic Perspective, Int J Psychiatr Res 9(4):1-7
based_on.key_sentence: A code or data without recognition is just noise posing as information.

semantic_mapping.code_or_data: 内核产出的 verdict 读数(各只读探针返回值 + 台账 verdict)
semantic_mapping.recognition: 判定权归属锚点: ①DECISIONS user_verdict/status=EXECUTED ②gap_archive RESOLVED_EXECUTED ③探针声明判定权归用户且verdict_unchanged=True且is_gate_verdict=False
semantic_mapping.noise: 读数存在但无判定权归属锚点=伪装成信息的噪音(不替裁定,只标注)

locked_rules.R1: 逐 verdict 载体分类: RECOGNIZED_USER(有DECISIONS user_verdict+EXECUTED) / RECOGNIZED_ARCHIVE(gap_archive RESOLVED_EXECUTED) / RECOGNIZED_DECLARED(探针声明判定权归用户+verdict_unchanged+非门) / UNRECOGNIZED_NOISE(都无)
locked_rules.R2: recognition_flag: NO_VERDICT_CLAIM(无读数) / ALL_RECOGNIZED(全有锚点) / NOISE_PRESENT(存在无锚点读数)
locked_rules.R3: 只读: 不写盘、不消费、不进判定、不改任何verdict/权威态/DECISIONS/归档账
locked_rules.R4: 注入 verdict_sources/decisions_path/gap_archive_path 做隔离负向测试,生产恒 None 读真实
locked_rules.R5: verdict_unchanged=True, consumed=False, is_gate_verdict=False; one_page 结尾判定权归用户
locked_rules.R6: honesty 明确: 借原论文一句锋利镜面,不接受其神经科学结论;期刊低可信+COI如实记;不宣称内核有识别认知机制,只做判定权归属结构自检;原论文hypothesis未证实
locked_rules.R7: UNRECOGNIZED_NOISE 是标注非裁定: 不因发现噪音就删除读数或伪造裁定锚点

acceptance.G1_minimal: 纯新增1函数,AST OK,diff确认kernel仅增函数不改既有
acceptance.G2_real: 真实运行: 有verdict载体、有RECOGNIZED锚点、按真实数据暴露NOISE_PRESENT或ALL_RECOGNIZED,数字来自真实探针
acceptance.G3_negative: 负向注入全真失败: 无锚点verdict必NOISE_PRESENT且UNRECOGNIZED_NOISE; DECISIONS EXECUTED+user_verdict必RECOGNIZED_USER; RESOLVED_EXECUTED必RECOGNIZED_ARCHIVE; 声明判定权归用户+verdict_unchanged必RECOGNIZED_DECLARED; 空注入NO_VERDICT_CLAIM
acceptance.G4_readonly: 不写盘不消费不进判定;权威态四件套+DECISIONS+gap_archive哈希前后一致
acceptance.G6_regression: 干净同口径对拍: 备份内核+基线测试=原passed数; 新内核+全量=原+n守卫; 零回归

will_not_change: kernel既有函数/阈值/权威态四件套
任何既有 verdict / 11条心跳判定 / tagbook
原论文任何结论(仅借镜面)
boundary: 不宣称内核有真实recognition认知机制;只做判定权归属的结构自检镜;不替用户裁定任何一条读数;判定权归用户
